subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok code-less decrypt error?
rationale: External PRs normally need after-fix real behavior proof, but the contributor provided a plausible provider-side trigger constraint that review automation cannot settle without maintainer proof-policy judgment.

options.title: Accept Evidence Exception
options.body: Treat the redacted production logs and focused regression tests as sufficient for this narrow predicate-only change, then refresh exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Keep Proof Gate
options.body: Require an organic after-fix Grok/gateway capture before merge, accepting that the PR may wait for a future xAI rotation event.

options.title: Maintainer-Owned Reproduction
options.body: Have a maintainer with xAI/Grok production access instrument or inspect the next rotation event before deciding.

recommendation.title: Accept Evidence Exception
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted production logs and focused regression tests as sufficient for this narrow predicate-only change, then refresh exact-head checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate from the prior merged work on the same encrypted-content retry predicate.
